candidates.title: FairCache: Demystifying Cache-Induced Unfairness in Multi-Tenant Large Language Model Serving
candidates.reason: Direct LLM serving systems contribution: jointly accounts for compute, cache memory and I/O fairness, redistributes shared-prefix prefill cost, and adds fairness-aware cache management for multi-tenant context caching.

candidates.title: CALSI: Context-Aware Layer Skipping Inference for On-Device LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Direct on-device LLM inference system using token/context-aware layer skipping plus delayed KV-cache computation; reports up to 24.1% latency reduction on real devices.
